title: Clawd X Digest
summary: SpaceX .6B Defense Contract: SpaceX was awarded a .6 billion U.S. Space Force contract for national security space launches.

AI Infrastructure & Local Models: xAI launched Grok’s one-prompt app generator, Nous Research introduced Hermes Agent for Buzz workspaces, and developers demonstrated local execution of the 2.8T Kimi K3 model on Apple M1 Max hardware.

Tech Fund Rebound & Tokenized Assets: Market analysts highlighted a sharp rally in Leopold Aschenbrenner’s tech holdings, while wallet tracking mapped 83% of the B tokenized real-world asset (RWA) market.
China Politburo Economic Policy: China’s Politburo set its Fifth Plenum for October and signaled upcoming incremental policy support to address economic headwinds.
Bitcoin Protocol Governance (BIP-110): Discussions intensified around BIP-110, a proposed soft-fork mechanism aimed at limiting state growth and refining protocol rules.

items.title: @grok: Grok Releases One-Prompt Web & Mobile App Generator
items.body: xAI launched an integrated app generator allowing SuperGrok Heavy users to turn a single text prompt into a deployed web, iOS, or Android application with a custom domain.

items.title: @NousResearch: Hermes Agent Integrated with Buzz Workspaces
items.body: Nous Research announced Hermes Agent support for Buzz, a self-hostable workspace that enables human developers and AI agents to collaborate in shared channels and codebases.

items.title: @Xudong07452910: 2.8T Kimi K3 Model Executed Locally on Apple M1 Max
items.body: Developers showcased running the open-source 2.8 trillion parameter Kimi K3 model locally on an Apple M1 Max via Deltafin, requiring 1.7 TB disk space at 0.0687 tokens per second.

items.title: @CauraAI: Frontier AI Blind Evaluation & Opus 5 Benchmark
items.body: Caura published blind multi-model evaluation results across 100 questions, with Claude Opus 5 placing first with an 8.87 rating while Fable 5 secured third place.

items.title: @haider1: GPT-6 Base Model Compute Scaling
items.body: Industry reports indicate GPT-6 entered base model training earlier than anticipated following post-training architecture optimizations and compute cluster expansion.

items.title: @Avi_hacker1: Open-Source Browser Racing Sim Coded by AI Agents
items.body: Developers showcased a browser-based open-source racing simulator featuring graphics and physics code generated using Fable, Opus, and GPT-5.6.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: SpaceX Awarded .6 Billion Space Force Contract
items.body: SpaceX secured a .6 billion contract from the U.S. Space Force for national security space launch operations.

items.title: @SixSigmaCapital: Leopold Aschenbrenner Tech Fund Rally
items.body: Market commentators noted a strong rebound across Leopold Aschenbrenner’s tech holdings following sharp drawdowns in AI infrastructure stocks during July.

items.title: @niubi: China Politburo Readout Signals Policy Support
items.body: China’s Politburo scheduled its Fifth Plenum for October while emphasizing the need for targeted incremental policy measures to support economic performance.

items.title: @galka_max: On-Chain Wallet Analysis of B Tokenized RWAs
items.body: Data analysts mapped 83% of wallet addresses holding  billion in tokenized real-world assets (RWAs), detailing institutional concentration.

items.title: @FoxBusiness: Art Laffer on Gold as Dollar Standard
items.body: Former Reagan economic adviser Art Laffer discussed gold price benchmarks as the primary gauge of real dollar purchasing power.

items.title: @DrStarHeartsong: Bitcoin BIP-110 Soft Fork Debate
items.body: Bitcoin developers outlined BIP-110, a temporary constitutional soft fork proposal designed to reduce state bloat and mitigate SegWit/Taproot side effects.

items.title: @Eva200699: Elon Musk 2003 Stanford Lecture Insights
items.body: A deep dive into Elon Musk’s 2003 closed-door Stanford lecture gained viral traction, breaking down first-principles startup survival across Zip2, PayPal, and early SpaceX.

items.title: @SpiderManMovie: Spider-Man Brand New Day Hits Theaters
items.body: Sony and Marvel Studios highlighted global theatrical release momentum for Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
